description: Board of Investment of Sri Lanka - Rules made to amend the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka (Fees and Charges) Rules
reasoning: This gazette contains amendments to rules and fees under the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka Law, No. 4 of 1978. It involves regulatory changes to fee structures and charges for various investment-related activities, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. The content does not involve government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories like land, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. It represents subsidiary legislation made under an existing law.
